name: ActionSheet
purpose: Presents a set of contextual actions in a bottom-anchored panel; the compact-screen morph target of Dialog.
scenarios: Offer share, edit, and delete actions for a list item
Confirm a destructive choice with a visible cancel escape
Collect one choice on a phone without leaving the current page

actions.description: Array of actions with value and label.

onOpenChange.description: Called when open state changes (trigger, Escape, backdrop, cancel, or drag dismiss).

onAction.description: Called with the action value when an action is chosen; the sheet then closes.

states.name: open
states.description: Sheet is visible; focus is trapped inside.

states.name: closed
states.description: Sheet is hidden; only the trigger is in the tab order.

antiPatterns: Do not open multiple action sheets.
Do not use for long forms; use Dialog or a page instead.
Do not remove the cancel control; it is the always-visible escape.

a11y.focus: Focus moves inside on open and returns to the trigger on close; delegated to Ark UI / Zag focus trap.
a11y.labeling: Title labels the sheet; every action is a real button with its visible label.

responsive.strategy: Bottom-anchored full-width panel with drag handle on compact; bounded centered panel without the handle on tablet and desktop. The morph is container-driven via the viewport-sized positioner.

breakpoints.compact: Full-width bottom panel; drag handle visible, swipe down or Escape closes; action and cancel hit areas >= 44px.
breakpoints.medium: Centered panel with max inline size 30rem; drag handle hidden; Escape and cancel close.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only; the panel is block-end anchored and direction-neutral, actions stack in document order.
